description: This file defines a mock class 'SugarBeanMock' that extends the 'SugarBean' class, used primarily for unit testing purposes. It includes methods for constructing the mock object, parsing date defaults, building subqueries, setting loaded relationships, and retrieving encryption keys, as well as various class properties and initializations.
